name: Jay Rajput
title: Social Media Manager
bio: I'm a Social Media Manager focused on Instagram, short-form content and digital storytelling. I work at the intersection of strategy, creativity and internet culture — turning ideas into content people actually stop to watch, share and remember.
shortBio: Social Media Manager focused on Instagram, content, strategy and growth. I turn ideas into content people stop scrolling for.

about.story: Managed digital storytelling and community-driven content systems across high-growth social media channels. Focused on testing formats, understanding algorithmic behavior, and turning internet culture into repeatable engagement patterns. Passionate about creating social-first media that earns and retains genuine audience attention.
about.philosophy: Attention is earned in the first second and kept by every second after.
